description: Defines the rlc_rx_um_entity class and related data structures for handling UM RLC reception, including SDU segment buffering, reassembly, and timer management, following 3GPP TS 38.322 specifications.

classes.name: rlc_rx_um_entity
classes.description: Handles UM RLC reception, including SDU segment buffering, reassembly, and timer management.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all timers associated with the entity.

methods.name: on_expired_reassembly_timer
methods.description: Handles expiration of the reassembly timer.

methods.name: handle_segment_data_sdu
methods.description: Handles a received SDU segment contained in a PDU.

methods.name: store_segment
methods.description: Stores a new SDU segment, avoiding overlaps.

methods.name: update_segment_inventory
methods.description: Checks if SDU is fully received and segments are contiguous.

methods.name: reassemble_sdu
methods.description: Reassembles a complete SDU from buffered segments.

methods.name: sn_in_reassembly_window
methods.description: Checks if a sequence number is within the reassembly window.

methods.name: sn_invalid_for_rx_buffer
methods.description: Checks if a sequence number is invalid for reception buffer.

methods.name: rx_mod_base
methods.description: Calculates the modular base for sequence number wrapping.

methods.name: log_state
methods.description: Logs the current state of the RLC entity.
